subject: I have
author: Flamechu
body: I've really considered getting a PSP. I already played and beat Legends, and Dominator seems it has less overall play time. Unless a new Burnout PSP game is announced, has online play, and totally blows my mind, I'm going to save my money for a Wii.

subject: PSP
author: ZombieTron
body:
The PSP is a nice little hand held console, and you can watch stuff on it too! Great for long train journeys, playing Burnout: Dominator and Legends or watching DL'd episodes of your favourite TV shows. It's definitely worth considering. Don't beat yourself up about it! 🙂
